_meta.authored_by: Anthony Ugwu (AI-assisted drafting; quoted spans and source URLs human-verified)
authoring_notes: Claude drafted via WebFetch of pickle.com (note: getpickle.ai 301-redirects to pickle.com — updated seed_url in companies.py as a follow-up if needed).

IMPORTANT PIVOT FINDING: TechCrunch W25 coverage described Pickle as 'AI video avatar / lip-sync for video calls'. The live pickle.com site now positions Pickle as an 'AI memory layer' — the company has pivoted. This gold is written against the CURRENT positioning so Phase 4's retrieval-then-check pipeline scores honestly.
source_text == quoted_span per the schema compromise noted in browser-use.json. WebFetch returns short verbatim quotes, not full paragraphs; we avoid fabricating context around them.
Shorter gold than browser-use (6 claims vs 10) because pickle.com's public content is thinner.

claims.claim_text: Pickle positions itself as a personal memory layer that gives AI continuity across your everyday activity.
claims.quoted_span: Pickle builds a living memory from your everyday moments so your AI truly knows you.
claims.source_text: Pickle builds a living memory from your everyday moments so your AI truly knows you.

claims.claim_text: The product is framed as a cross-model memory substrate, not a feature bolted into one AI.
claims.quoted_span: Pickle brings everything you've said, done, and learned into one memory layer that works across any AI
claims.source_text: Pickle brings everything you've said, done, and learned into one memory layer that works across any AI

claims.claim_text: Pickle describes three core capabilities: distilling raw data into episodes, predicting intent from recalled memory, and iterative personalization.
claims.quoted_span: Weave: Distills raw data into standardized episodes and find patterns.
claims.source_text: Weave: Distills raw data into standardized episodes and find patterns.

claims.claim_text: The 'Predict' capability is positioned as proactive rather than reactive AI recall.
claims.quoted_span: Predict: Reads your intent by recalling the right memories so AI can take proactive action.
claims.source_text: Predict: Reads your intent by recalling the right memories so AI can take proactive action.

claims.claim_text: Pickle's security positioning emphasizes secure enclaves and user-only access to stored memories — a direct response to the data-privacy risks inherent in a personal-memory product.
claims.quoted_span: Built on secure enclaves and open-source code, your memories stay accessible only to you.
claims.source_text: Built on secure enclaves and open-source code, your memories stay accessible only to you.

claims.claim_text: Pickle targets the consumer AI personalization market — positioning against generic chat history and conventional RAG memory stores.
claims.quoted_span: memory layer that works across any AI
claims.source_text: memory layer that works across any AI

claims.claim_text: Ask the founders about their pivot from the W25 Demo Day video-avatar positioning to the current memory-layer product — what triggered the change, and what did they learn from the first thesis that shaped the second?
Memory-layer products historically struggle with cold-start — without enough user-generated episodes, the 'Predict' capability produces little value. Worth probing their onboarding strategy.
claims.quoted_span: Evolve: Gets sharper and more personal with every interaction.
claims.source_text: Evolve: Gets sharper and more personal with every interaction.
